decisions.text: behaviour: the base box lost its close (x) button; an outside tap, a scroll or a second tap on its control closes it — reverse: add the button back in the template

behaviour: the base box is a popover="manual" (top layer) because a fixed box inside the count grid rendered about 156px off its computed position — reverse: drop the attribute and the showPopover call
removes: app-modal-shell [light] input, its template hook and its spec (no template uses it now) — reverse: git revert this plan's commit
seen: src/styles.scss:687 — .c-modal-overlay--light is now unused; styles.scss is append-only for this plan, so it was left in place

behaviour: the ⓘ opens on hover or focus above phone width and closes on leave or blur; a click there does nothing, and on a phone a second tap closes it — reverse: restore the click toggle and the title attribute

behaviour: the RTL test asserts computed left equals the placed left and right equals clientWidth minus left minus width, because Chrome returns a px value for a placed fixed box's right, not 'auto' — reverse: none needed, the assertion fails if the right inset is set again

seen: src/app/pages/inventory/components/stock-count/stock-count.component.ts:406 — in an RTL page with a vertical scrollbar, `placeInViewport` uses clientWidth, but fixed `left` starts at the scrollbar's edge, so the box can sit about 15px right of its intended spot; this was seen in the test browser, not checked on a real device
